The president’s popularity differs across the country.

According to Civiqs' online polling, as of late August, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 percent disapprove.

The president’s weakest numbers can be found in Democratic strongholds. His approval rating is weakest in Hawaii, where 18 percent approve of his job performance, and 81 percent disapprove. [...] The most recent polling data from The Economist and YouGov, taken August 21-28 found that 36 percent of Hispanic voters approved of how Trump is handling his job.

results.content:
According to Civiqs, last updated August 12, Trump's net approval in New Jersey stood at -35%.

New Jersey tilts unfavorable overall. About 65% of New Jersey residents polled currently disapprove of the president's performance.About 30% approve and another 5% did not choose either.

Education: Respondents across all education levels disapprove of Trump’s job performance, with postgraduate at 78%, college graduate at 67% and non-college graduate at 60%. [...] Party: Democrats were most unfavorable toward Trump, with 98% disapproving, followed by independents at 62% disapproval. Meanwhile, Republicans were the most favorable toward Trump, with 82% approving of Trump's job performance.

Race: B

results.content: Civiqs has been tracking this since the day Trump took the oath, and as of late July, Trump’s net approval in Texas sits at -13. Texas is one of eleven states Trump carried by double digits in 2024 where he’s now underwater, in the “should have been safe but isn’t” column.
